title: Support case
description: One customer contact and its handling, at support/cases/<id>.json (route support/cases/[id]): a question, a problem, a request or a complaint, tagged with a contact reason, from first reply to resolution. It follows APQC PCF 6.2.2 and 6.2.3 (manage problems, requests and inquiries; manage complaints) and ISO 10002:2018 for complaints. The customer service function owns it, and only the customer service agent (role customer-service-agent) or a person writes it. It holds no transcript and no contact details: the customer is a customer record id, and the conversation stays in the helpdesk, named by its external id.

id.description: The case's id, the file name without .json

kind.description: complaint: an expression of dissatisfaction that needs a response (ISO 10002); a person closes it

customer.description: The customer record (customers/<id>.json), when the contact is a known customer

external_id.description: The conversation's id in the helpdesk tool, where the messages stay

summary.description: What the customer needs, in a sentence, with no personal details

reason.description: The contact reason, from the support policy's reasons

first_response.description: When the first reply went out; null while none has

resolution.description: What fixed it, or the answer given

root_cause.description: Why it happened, for a problem or a complaint

repeat_of.description: An earlier case on the same issue for the same customer, so repeat contacts can be counted

bug.description: The bug record (product/bugs/<id>.json) it was filed as

refund.description: A refund or credit granted on the case, with the decision that approved it

decision.description: The id of the spend-money decision a person made
